info.description: API test collection for the ParaBank public demo, mirroring the API Test Cases sheet of test-cases.xlsx (API-AUTH-001/002, API-ACCT-001..003, API-TRF-001, API-TXN-001, API-SESS-001). Only the published public demo account is used. Demo data resets periodically: if the login request fails, refresh customerId/accountId from a fresh successful login before running the dependent requests.
info.name: ParaBank API — Digital Banking QA

exec: pm.test('Customer record contains an id', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('<id>'); });

item.name: API-AUTH-001 — Valid login returns the customer record

request.description: Expected: HTTP 200 with an XML customer record containing the customer id.

exec: pm.test('Error message is returned', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('Invalid username and/or password'); });

request.description: Expected: HTTP 400 with 'Invalid username and/or password'. Note: the web UI login does not reject a wrong password (see BUG-001 in test-cases.xlsx); the API does.

item.name: API-ACCT-001 — List accounts of an existing customer

request.description: Expected: HTTP 200 with an XML list of accounts (id, customerId, type, balance).

exec: pm.test('Error mentions the account', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('Could not find account'); });

item.name: API-ACCT-002 — Unknown account id returns an error

request.description: Expected: HTTP 400 with an error stating the account could not be found. Use an id that is unassigned at run time.

exec: pm.test('Error mentions the customer', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('Could not find customer'); });

item.name: API-ACCT-003 — Unknown customer id returns an error

request.description: Expected: HTTP 400 with an error stating the customer could not be found.

item.name: API-TXN-001 — Get transactions of an account

request.description: Expected: HTTP 200 with an XML list of transactions for the account (may be empty for a new account).

exec: pm.test('Confirmation message is returned', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('Successfully transferred'); });

item.name: API-TRF-001 — Transfer between own accounts updates both balances

request.description: Expected: HTTP 200 with a confirmation message. Verify with API-ACCT-001 / account GETs that the source balance decreased and the target balance increased by exactly the amount. Executed and verified on 2026-11-23 (EXEC-006 in test-cases.xlsx).

exec: pm.test('No customer record is returned', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include('<customer>'); });

item.name: API-SESS-001 — Malformed login request (missing password) is rejected

request.description: Expected: HTTP 400 or 404, and no customer data is returned. Observed: HTTP 404 (EXEC-006).
